videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team treat a lorry driver trapped behind his twisted steering wheel and help is urgently required for a 12-year-old who appears to be drunk after drinking an unknown substance.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The discovery of underwear on a canal bank sparks a risky missing persons search and a police incident ends in a fleeing car passenger jumping over a wall and breaking his leg.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A major fire breaks out in a haulage depot in Brighouse and a serious accident at an illegal off-road biking site leads to a rider needing urgent hospital treatment.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A skier falls over on a steep slope and suffers a suspected brain injury in Wakefield and a DIY enthusiast's attempts to fix the heating in his chilly home end in disaster.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The start of the new school term leads of a spate of stabbing's and a forester is badly injured in an accident involving a chainsaw deep in woods near Keighley.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The work of NHS emergency response teams. Staff are scrambled to a block of flats after an explosion causes multiple casualties and a driver is trapped after his lorry hits a tree.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A teenager is found with multiple stab wounds in the street near his home, an amateur tree surgeon is badly hurt when a branch falls on his leg and two schoolgirls are run over.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team joins the search for a missing aeroplane pilot and passenger. A man digging for antique bottles in a South Yorkshire tip is buried alive, leading to a desperate fight to save him.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A student climber plunges from a cliff face in Wharfedale and the team fears he has broken his neck. The medics are also called to treat the victim of a stabbing at a meat plant.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The medics spring into action when a cyclist plunges down a cliff in a freak accident. A homeowner's booby trap, designed to deter burglars, sparks a major rescue operation.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A car crash victim has to be put into an induced coma at the roadside. Andy is called in to stand by as bomb disposal experts deal with a mortar dating back to the Boer War.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The response teams rush to save the life of a 21-year-old man who has been shot twice in the chest at a Doncaster pub. Another man has a seizure in the cab of his tipper truck.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: A doctor on his way home from work is left fighting for his life after a head-on collision with a truck. Leeds paramedic Chris is called to a motorcyclist who has been hit by a taxi.

videos.title: 999: Rescue Squad
videos.description: The teams stand by for casualties as police launch an armed raid on the home of a wanted man. A minibus carrying children with special needs is in collision with a stolen car.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Paramedics have their hands full with a high-speed motorcycle crash, a woman with abdominal pain and an old lady who has fallen, injuring her face.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Today, crews struggle to reach a woman who has fallen from her horse on treacherous boggy ground. Paramedics also treat a 14-year-old boy in agony with suspected appendicitis.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Paramedics attend a father and son whose car has been hit by a falling tree on a dark and stormy night, and are called out to assist a homeless woman sheltering in a bin shed.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Paramedics from the South Central Ambulance Service treat a site foreman having a heart attack on a building site and a woman who has hit her head on sharp gardening shears.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Paramedics in Oxford race to an 8-month-old baby who needs urgent help to breathe. In Portsmouth, a cancer patient thinks her chemotherapy drugs are causing her chest pain.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The South Central crews help a boy who has dislocated his knee during a school rugby match and a man suffering with agonising stomach pains after eating a bacon sandwich.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Crews help a family whose car has crashed into a ditch, a woman with fast and erratic breathing, and a partially paralysed woman who's suffered a head injury in her garden.
